name: International Protection (Protección Internacional)

requirements.blocker_text: This can only be claimed while on Spanish territory or at a border post.

This requires meeting one of two categories: refugee status (estatuto de refugiado — persecution based on race, religion, nationality, political opinion, membership of a social group, gender, or sexual orientation under the 1951 Geneva Convention) or subsidiary protection (protección subsidiaria — real risk of serious harm including death penalty, torture, or indiscriminate violence in armed conflict).

evidence_required.document: Evidence supporting the persecution or serious-harm claim
Attendance at CIAR/Oficina de Asilo y Refugio screening and interview

notes: No application fee, consistent with every other country's asylum route in this dataset. Both protection statuses grant the SAME 5-year duration in Spain, a genuine structural simplicity relative to Germany, Netherlands, and Portugal's asylum routes, all of which differentiate duration by status (typically shorter for subsidiary protection) — worth surfacing as a real, confirmed cross-country difference. work_rights marked 'restricted' rather than 'full' specifically because the right to work only activates after 6 months from application, not immediately upon status grant — a genuine timing nuance not present on several other countries' asylum routes in this dataset. citizenship_after_months (60) uses the REFUGEE-specific 5-year naturalisation track (a reduced track distinct from the 10-year general route) rather than the standard figure — refugees get meaningfully faster access to citizenship in Spain, worth surfacing prominently. VOLUME CONTEXT, tier-1 confirmed and worth including for realism: Spain formalized 144,396 international-protection applications in 2025 (Ministerio del Interior, published 16 January 2026), the THIRD-LARGEST volume in the EU behind Germany and France — Venezuela led with 85,413 applications (59.2% of the total); overall recognition rate was 11.2%. This corrects a ~180,000 figure circulating on some tier-3 sites, which appears to be an overstatement.
